title: Development Plan Document Record
description: A document associated with a development plan, aligned with the planning.data.gov.uk development-plan-document dataset: https://digital-land.github.io/specification/dataset/development-plan-document/
$comment: Reviewed against the planning.data.gov.uk development-plan-document specification on 2026-10-16.

reference.description: A reference for the document that is unique within the dataset and permanent.

development-plan.description: The reference of the development plan the document belongs to.

document-types.description: The types of document this record refers to.

document-url.description: The URL of the document file itself.

documentation-url.description: The web page where the documentation for the document can be found.

notes.description: Notes on how the data was made or how it can be interpreted.

organisation.description: The organisation responsible for the record.

entry-date.description: The date this information was entered as a record.

start-date.description: The date the validity of the record starts.

end-date.description: The date the validity of the record ends.

date.description: A date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

curie.description: A compact identifier made of a prefix, a colon and a reference, such as local-authority:BUC.
